description: Zephyr RTOS sample code demonstrating zbus message bus with priority boosting, multiple threads, and listeners.

methods.name: t1_thread
methods.description: Main thread function that publishes messages and adjusts observer enable states based on a counter.

methods.name: s1_thread
methods.description: Subscriber thread that waits for messages on s1 and logs thread priority.

methods.name: ms1_thread
methods.description: Message subscriber thread for ms1 that logs received message and thread priority.

methods.name: ms2_thread
methods.description: Message subscriber thread for ms2 that logs received message and thread priority.

methods.name: l1_callback
methods.description: Listener callback for l1 channel that logs message and thread priority.

methods.name: l2_callback
methods.description: Listener callback for l2 channel that logs message and thread priority.
